objective: Exploratory census under a frozen contract: chains of three rings with shared contacts (proposal parities and self-blind parities, the same law at both contacts), the 88 rule classes on all three rings, declared sizes, exact at every lag where the dynamics repeats within a cap: how often each contact binds its two rings at every lag, how often c2 binds the end rings A and C at every lag from the light-cone lag on, and whether the second holds whenever the first holds for both contacts (a composition law across time).
status: Supported 2026-11-08 (exploratory): of 5,632 chains (5,579 decided), both contacts persist in 182 and in none of them does either contact bind the end rings from the light-cone lag on (H1 fails); the far ring's influence at c2 is absent (rings reading no neighbour, blocking, cancellation between the two ways round), fades, or can be overridden; the ends are bound at c2 in only 2 chains, neither keeping both contacts. Controls passed.
title: Chains of three rings
